notes: Descriptions are refined incrementally from code inspection; route modules now include active-vs-legacy context where relevant.
LOC values are line-count snapshots so automations can flag files whose descriptions may need refresh after edits.

directories.description: Solidary site app workspace (React + Vite) containing the landing, studio, site-create, and site-builder frontend.
Public static assets served as-is by Vite and the deployed site.
App source tree plus raw templates used to scaffold repository content.
Primary application module containing router shell (`App.tsx`), global styles, shared layout components, cross-route features, and route folders.
App-local static assets (currently scaffold leftovers).
Global shell components reused across routes (currently `SiteHeader` and `SiteFooter`).
Cross-route business features (auth session management and site-draft content modeling/build helpers).
Global authentication feature built on Supabase session state with GitHub OAuth sign-in/out actions.
Auth feature UI guards and presentation helpers consumed by route-level composition.
Auth feature context definitions shared across providers and hooks.
Auth feature hooks for safe context consumption and auth state access.
Auth feature providers that connect Supabase auth lifecycle to React context state.
Cross-route draft-content feature defining canonical site/page data shapes and transformation helpers.
Pure transformation/parsing helpers for Solidary metadata and Astro template generation.
Small shared utilities for Supabase client bootstrap, slug normalization, and browser-safe base64 encoding.
Route entry modules for landing (public) and studio/site-create/site-builder (auth-guarded).
Public landing route module for first-touch marketing copy and entry into authenticated app flows.
Authenticated site-builder route module for collaborative editing, locking, draft persistence, and publish workflows.
Builder UI components for top-level layout, section editors, formatting controls, and live preview rendering.
Builder hooks coordinating controller state, section/page navigation, locks, presence, collaborators, and publish tracking.
Builder service layer for draft loading/saving, lock transitions, file generation, and shared domain utilities.
Publish workflow services for owner direct publish and editor pull-request publish flows.
Authenticated route module for provisioning a new GitHub-backed site and seeding its initial Supabase draft records before entering the builder.
Presentation components for site metadata input and provisioning progress feedback.
Route-local controller hook for form state, image preview lifecycle, auth/token validation, and create-site orchestration.
Provisioning service layer that coordinates GitHub repo/job/publish setup and writes initial site draft data into Supabase.
Authenticated dashboard route that aggregates owned + shared sites into a single list with role visibility, delete actions, and placeholder index tooling.
Studio UI components used by the active route shell (site list, index placeholder, and delete dialog).
Route hooks for loading draft/PR data, mutating site records, and composing Studio view props/state.
Studio mappers and route-local domain types for translating draft file metadata into card-friendly models.
App-wide network adapters (currently GitHub Netlify-function wrappers for repository file operations).
Shared lightweight app-level types (currently notice severity union used by route footers/controllers).
Raw template assets imported and written into newly provisioned Astro repositories.
Astro scaffold templates with placeholder tokens for site metadata, pages, protocol file, and design tokens.

files.description: App-level git ignore rules for logs, local files, editor metadata, and build output.
Maintainability and architecture rules for this app.
Flat ESLint configuration combining JS/TypeScript recommendations with React hooks + Vite React-refresh rules, while ignoring `dist`.
Vite HTML entry template that mounts the React root, loads `/src/main.tsx`, and defines base document metadata/favicon.
App workspace package manifest (still named `studio`) defining local scripts and React/Supabase tooling dependencies.
Vite scaffold favicon served as a static public asset.
Default Vite React+TypeScript README retained from initial scaffold.
Primary UI stylesheet for shared layout and route components (header, landing, studio cards/dialogs, and builder scaffolding).
Top-level application shell that wires AuthProvider, BrowserRouter, and route-level auth guards.
Global footer that shows Supabase env setup warnings and route-level notice/error messages.
Global header with home brand link and auth-aware profile dropdown for GitHub sign-in, Studio link, and sign-out.
Auth gate component that waits for auth resolution and redirects unauthenticated users from protected routes back to `/`.
Defines the global auth context shape (`session`, `sessionResolved`, `signInWithGitHub`, `signOut`) and exports the nullable React context instance.
Thin guard hook around `AuthContext` that throws if used outside `AuthProvider`.
Hydrates auth state from Supabase (`getSession` + `onAuthStateChange`) and exposes GitHub OAuth sign-in (repo/delete/workflow scopes) plus sign-out actions.
Template-based builders that render `site.ts` and page markdown files by injecting normalized settings/page values into Astro templates.
Minimal parser for `.well-known/solidary-links.json` content that safely returns typed metadata or `null` on invalid JSON.
Shared draft content contracts (`RepoFileSet`, `AstroSettings`, `AstroPageDraft`, header/footer shapes) reused by create, studio, and builder flows.
Converts ArrayBuffer payloads into base64 strings in chunked mode to avoid call-stack overflow.
Normalizes freeform titles into URL/repository-safe slugs.
Initializes the shared Supabase client from Vite env vars and exports a configuration presence check.
Route barrel re-export for the landing route entry component.
Public homepage route that renders brand messaging, feature highlights, and primary navigation into the authenticated Studio flow.
Rich Astro-style preview surface with editable content, markdown-to-HTML rendering, image/caption controls, header/footer simulation, and imperative editor commands.
Topbar action cluster for save/publish buttons and publish progress/success/error feedback links.
Metadata and collaborator-management form section for title/description/URL/image plus invite/role/remove collaborator flows.
Formatting toolbar UI (text styles, alignment, lists, links, image URL/upload, clear formatting) for the live preview editor.
Footer settings editor for visibility/fixed mode, module content/alignment, and module ordering controls.
Header settings editor for visibility/fixed mode, home-link brand text, and nav item ordering.
Inspector panel for the currently selected preview image (alt text, caption, and size slider).
Pages management UI that switches between page list mode and per-page title/slug edit mode with lock indicators.
Preview shell that handles loading/error/read-only states, formatting toolbar rail, and AstroTemplatePreview mounting.
Primary builder sidebar that routes section navigation and renders the appropriate settings/metadata sub-section with lock-aware disabling.
Styles settings section for editing token CSS used by the preview and generated site files.
Reusable SVG icon set used by builder formatting and alignment controls.
Sticky builder topbar showing external links, role/presence pills, fullscreen toggle, and save/publish action block.
Hook for collaborator search, invite, role updates, removals, and managed-collaborator list loading/sync via Supabase RPC + Netlify GitHub functions.
Hook for page CRUD-ish editing helpers (add/update slug/title/body), touched/deleted slug tracking, nav ordering, and footer module reordering.
Hook wrapping preview editor commands, selected image state, and inline image uploads to Supabase storage + draft image metadata records.
Section/page navigation coordinator that delegates lock-aware transitions and exposes route-level navigation handlers.
Type contracts for section-navigation hook inputs/outputs and lock/save callbacks.
Realtime presence hook that tracks active collaborators and active page slug per user through Supabase Realtime presence channels.
Section-lock hook for polling/acquiring/releasing draft section locks and releasing all locks on pagehide/unmount.
Publish status polling hook that tracks GitHub deployment workflow progress and emits publish feedback/error/success callbacks.
Primary site-builder controller: draft loading, role/lock state, section saves, publish flows (owner vs editor), collaborator/presence wiring, and UI prop composition.
Route boundary re-export for SiteBuilderRoute and its controller hook.
Builds publishable repository file set (site config, tokens, solidary metadata, and page markdown) from current builder state.
Pure mappers/normalizers for collaborator search rows, managed collaborator API rows, and invite identifier parsing.
Shared builder file-path constants for generated site config, tokens, solidary metadata, and page content paths.
Draft utility layer for image-path/url helpers, footer normalization, page-row creation, and deterministic draft-save signatures.
Loads draft state from Supabase, resolves access role/editor draft fallback, and hydrates pages/settings/images into controller-ready structures.
Section/page lock-key utilities and label helpers used to map UI state to lock records and editable section semantics.
Facade re-export for owner/editor publish service implementations and shared publish types.
Editor-publish helpers for building touched-file diffs, creating collaboration PRs, and loading latest touched state from Supabase.
Publish module index that re-exports owner/editor publish entrypoints and publish type contracts.
Editor publish flow that commits touched changes to collaboration branch and opens/updates a pull request for owner/admin review.
Owner/admin publish flow that saves draft, uploads assets/files, updates site metadata, and starts deployment status tracking.
Shared publish helpers for image path resolution, touched-set normalization, loading draft images, and uploading draft images to GitHub.
Type contracts shared by publish services (common params, owner/editor params, tracking payloads, and batch commit responses).
Atomic-ish draft persistence routine with optimistic revision checks, settings/page upserts, and conflict error signaling.
Editor-draft touched-state synchronization helpers and RPC wrapper for recording touched sections/pages/deletions.
Section-specific save routines for metadata and pages, including selective page upserts/deletes and touched slug propagation.
Helper for computing the current draft signature from route state for unsaved-change detection.
Section save routines for header/footer/styles via dedicated Supabase RPC endpoints.
Lock-aware section-transition workflow that acquires next locks, saves/releases current section, and refreshes draft data.
Lock-aware preview-page switching workflow that handles page lock handoff and optional save-before-switch behavior.
Core site-builder domain types for pages, draft state, roles, settings structures, and publish feedback payloads.
General builder helpers for slug normalization/uniqueness, preview image URL resolution, frontmatter stripping, and publish poll timing.
Site builder route orchestrator that composes topbar, sidebar/content sections, preview panel, and metadata full-view lock state.
Controlled form section for initial site title/description/JPEG image with actions to return to Studio or start provisioning.
Minimal progress section that shows a spinner and the current provisioning step label.

Primary create-site controller hook: default form values, image preview object URL cleanup, session/provider-token checks, provisioning invocation, and redirect to `/site-builder?draftId=...` on success.
Route barrel re-export for the default site-create route component.

End-to-end create-site workflow service that starts and polls async GitHub repo provisioning, enables Pages, waits for deployment, verifies live auth identity consistency, and inserts initial `sites`/`site_drafts`/`site_draft_settings`/`site_draft_pages` rows with structured diagnostic logging.
Thin route orchestrator that composes global header/footer and conditionally renders either metadata form or provisioning progress from controller state.
Modal confirmation flow for deleting a site either from builder data only or from both builder and GitHub (with typed repo-name confirmation).
Currently a placeholder index section with a create CTA and empty-state copy; does not yet manage real index records.
Primary card-grid section for site listings with loading/empty states, role label display, optional thumbnail rendering, and edit/delete actions.
Mutation hook for Studio-side operations: delete-site flows (builder-only vs builder+GitHub repo delete) and collaboration PR merge requests.
Data hook that loads owned drafts, resolves shared-access memberships/roles (including optional GitHub-admin role sync), fetches shared owner drafts, and loads open collaboration PR metadata.
Studio controller that merges owned/shared draft cards into one recency-sorted list, manages delete-dialog state/validation, and wires section action handlers/navigation.
Route barrel that re-exports the default Studio route component.
Mapper utilities that locate and parse Solidary metadata files in draft payloads, derive display title/description/site URL, and normalize thumbnail image URLs.
Route-local types for draft rows, access roles, collaboration PR cards, rendered site cards, and delete-dialog mode/target state.
Thin Studio route shell that composes global header/footer, renders "Your sites" plus the current index placeholder section, and mounts the delete dialog.
Shared GitHub API adapter wrapping Netlify function endpoints for file read/list/write/delete operations with base64 handling.
Common notice-level union (`"error" | "notice" | null`) used for route feedback banners and footer messaging state.
Global base styles: typography, background textures, form/control defaults, and markdown editor overrides.
Bootstraps the React app by rendering App inside StrictMode at the root DOM node.
Parameterized markdown page template used when creating draft-backed content pages.
Parameterized Astro site-config template used to generate `src/content/site.ts` for new repositories.
Parameterized Solidary protocol metadata template written to `.well-known/solidary-links.json`.
Default design token CSS template applied to newly provisioned sites.
Vite env type declarations for Supabase URL/keys (including both URL+anon and projectId+publishable-key forms).
Machine-readable project map with metadata, per-path descriptions, and per-file LOC snapshots.
Strict TypeScript config for browser app source (`src`), using bundler module resolution and React JSX with no emitted output.
TypeScript project-reference root that links browser (`tsconfig.app.json`) and tooling (`tsconfig.node.json`) build targets.
Strict TypeScript config for Node-side tooling files (currently `vite.config.ts`) with ES2023 libs and no emitted output.
Vite config for the app: React plugin, fixed local dev host/port, and proxying `/.netlify/functions` calls to Netlify dev on port 8888.
Unit tests for the Solidary metadata JSON parser, covering valid payload parsing and invalid JSON fallback behavior.
Unit tests for collaborator identifier normalization and collaborator row mapping used by the builder collaborator UI.
Unit tests for builder lock-key and label helpers, including page lock derivation from active slugs and sections.
